step1_analysis.description: A cross-coupled CMOS oscillator topology where MOS switches are directly coupled across the LC tank. The switches are driven by an input clock to inject charge, forcing the oscillator to lock to a sub-harmonic of the input frequency, thus acting as a high-frequency, low-power frequency divider.

paper_reference.title: A CMOS Direct Injection-Locked Oscillator Topology as High-Frequency Low-Power Frequency Divider

operating_frequency.description: The frequency of the output signal (divided frequency).

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the LC tank resonance f = 1/(2*pi*sqrt(L*C)). For L=2n, C=12.6f, f is approx 1 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down to 1 GHz for demonstration in the testbench using standard LC values, as 50 GHz is beyond typical simple SKY130 testbench targets without careful parasitic extraction.

power_consumption.description: Average DC power drawn from the supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_avg. With VDD=1.8V and I_avg ~2mA for the cross-coupled pair.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on transistor sizing; expected to be in the low milliwatt range similar to the paper.

locking_range.description: The range of input frequencies over which the oscillator successfully locks and divides by 2.

sky130_expected.calculation: Typically 10-20% of the center frequency depending on injection strength.
sky130_expected.reasoning: For a 1 GHz oscillator, a locking range of a few hundred MHz is expected.

output_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing of the output nodes.

sky130_expected.calculation: Limited by VDD (1.8V) and the tank impedance.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A healthy oscillation should swing close to rail-to-rail.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the output frequency, power consumption, and voltage swing of the injection-locked frequency divider.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Injection-Locked Frequency Divider Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=10u L_xm1=0.15u
.param W_xm2=20u L_xm2=0.15u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.15u
.param W_xm4=10u L_xm4=0.15u
.param W_xm5=20u L_xm5=0.15u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.15u

* DUT
XM1 QX Q VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 QX Q VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 Q INX QX GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 Q QX VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 Q QX VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 QX IN Q GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

* LC Tank (Required for oscillation, added to testbench)
L1 Q QX 2n
C1 Q QX 12.6f

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VGND GND 0 0
VIN IN 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 0.9 2G 0 0 0)
VINX INX 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 0.9 2G 0 0 180)

* Initial conditions to kickstart oscillation
.ic v(Q)=1.8 v(QX)=0

.control
tran 10p 50n

* Measure output frequency (divided frequency)
meas tran t_period trig v(Q) val=0.9 rise=10 targ v(Q) val=0.9 rise=11
let out_freq = 1 / t_period
print out_freq

* Measure power consumption
meas tran pwr_avg avg i(VVDD) from=10n to=50n
let power = -pwr_avg * 1.8
print power

* Measure output voltage swing
meas tran v_max max v(Q) from=10n to=50n
meas tran v_min min v(Q) from=10n to=50n
let swing = v_max - v_min
print swing

quit
.endc
